contexts: Labour and birth unit, about 4,200 births a year
Six fixed daily induction slots booked by the antenatal clinic
Lead midwife with one protected day per week
reading: Delays arise where a fixed booking process meets a labour ward whose capacity changes by the hour; the retrieved records describe the mechanism and its human cost but not the view of the people who make bookings and allocate beds. Women's experience while waiting and midwives' experience of surges are two faces of the same scheduling problem. A study that samples across the booking chain can show where redesign would help.
